draft:
**Tidepool landing page — build plan**

**Persistent left rail (desktop):** 240px column in deep-sea teal (#0B3B3C). Vertical week-timeline — Mon–Sun nodes on a thin "tide-line." Nodes light coral (#FF6B57) as you scroll past the section they map to: Monday = plan, midweek = adjust, Friday = look back. Collapses to a horizontal strip on mobile.

**Hero (right of rail, warm sand #FAF6EE):** One-sentence headline in Fraunces serif, ~44px, matching the run-on house style: *"Bring every member of your team together around one living plan that updates the moment anyone commits, remembers how long the work actually takes, and quietly takes the scramble out of Monday morning so nobody ever starts the week wondering who owns what."* Two CTAs: "Start your week" (coral, solid) and "See a planning ritual" (ghost). A hand-drawn ink arrow loops from the final clause down to the screenshot.

**Annotated product shot:** Tidepool board — days as columns, teammate avatars in a shared lane. Three sketchy callout circles: "@maya moved the launch," a scheduling-conflict flag, Friday's auto-generated retro.

**Monospace pull quote:** Full-width, JetBrains Mono, 28px, teal on sand, oversized coral quotation mark. Fictional team lead: "Our Monday meeting went from an hour to ten minutes. The plan was already done before we sat down." — attribution in small caps.

**How a week flows:** Three panels keyed to the rail nodes — Plan, Adjust, Look back. Flat illustration with tidepool motifs (anemones as avatars, driftwood as task cards); coral accents, no gradients.

**Quiet stats strip:** "2,400 small teams · 11-minute average Monday · zero orphaned tasks." Small, understated, sans-serif.

**Closing CTA:** Inverted — sand type on teal, headline fragment repeated ("Nobody forgets the milk"), coral button "Plan this week free."

**Footer:** Single tide-line, minimal links, © Tidepool.
final:
**Key fixes:** cut the borrowed "milk" callback (it belonged to the shopping app), reconciled the seven-node rail with the three-section story, tightened the headline, added a tools-integration strip.

**Left rail:** 240px, deep-sea teal (#0B3B3C). Seven day-nodes, but only three are labeled anchors — Mon "Plan," Wed "Adjust," Fri "Look back"; the other four render as small ticks so it reads as a week, not a nav menu. Active anchor fills coral (#FF6B57) on scroll along a thin animated tide-line. Collapses to a 32px top strip on mobile.

**Hero:** Warm sand (#FAF6EE), Fraunces at 44–48px, keeping the run-on house style but trimmed: *"Bring every person on your team around one living plan that updates the moment anyone commits, remembers how long the work actually takes, and quietly takes the scramble out of Monday morning so nobody starts the week wondering who owns what."* CTAs: "Start your week free" (coral solid) / "Watch a 90-second planning ritual" (ghost). Hand-drawn arrow from the final clause to the screenshot; it draws itself on scroll.

**Annotated product shot:** Real UI, not illustration — days as columns, teammates in a shared lane. Sketchy coral callouts: "@maya pulls the launch to Thursday," a conflict flag, Friday's auto-drafted retro.

**Monospace pull quote:** JetBrains Mono, 27px, teal on sand, oversized coral quote mark. Sharper fiction: *"Monday standup used to be an hour of status theater. Now the plan is already written when we sit down."* — Dana O., nine-person studio. Small-caps attribution.

**How a week flows:** Three panels keyed to the labeled rail anchors — Plan, Adjust, Look back. Tidepool motifs stay subtle: salt-grain texture, one line-drawn anemone per panel; the UI itself carries the visuals.

**Integration strip:** Grayscale logos — Slack, Google Calendar, Linear, GitHub — with "Your chats and commits already know the plan."

**Quiet stats:** "2,400 small teams · 11-minute Mondays · zero orphaned tasks."

**Closing CTA:** Inverted teal block, Tidepool-native line: *"Nobody starts the week wondering who owns what."* Coral button: "Plan this week free."

**Footer:** Single tide-line, minimal links, © Tidepool.
